format.use: Instagram Reel for a luxury barbershop

global_style.color_palette: strictly matte black, brushed gold and warm cream
global_style.lighting: moody low-key lighting, warm golden highlights from brass pendant lamps, deep blacks
global_style.grade: slightly desaturated cinematic grade, warm tones
global_style.lens: 35mm anamorphic look, subject razor sharp with crisp fine detail, soft creamy bokeh background
global_style.location: upscale modern barbershop, completely empty, no clients, matte black walls, cream marble floor, dark walnut counters
global_style.editing_rhythm: fast-paced cuts synced to a beat, inspired by premium barbershop social media reels

shots.subject: extreme macro of a matte black pomade jar with a brushed gold lid on a dark wooden shelf
shots.camera: fast rack focus from blurred foreground to the jar
shots.motion: golden light glinting on the lid

shots.subject: vintage barber pole with black and gold spiral stripes and a glowing cream-white globe on a dark wall
shots.camera: low angle close-up, quick upward tilt

shots.subject: macro of a professional gold metal hair clipper resting on black leather
shots.camera: fast lateral slide along the blade
shots.motion: sharp highlights moving across the gold teeth

shots.subject: ceiling of the salon with brass pendant lamps glowing warm
shots.motion: lamps glowing with a subtle flicker

shots.subject: gold straight razor opening slowly on a folded cream towel
shots.motion: blade catching a flash of golden light
shots.transition_out: cut to pure black for 0.2s on the beat drop

shots.subject: wide shot of the empty salon: two black leather barber chairs with gold details, round gold-framed mirrors, brass pendant lamps
shots.camera: slow smooth dolly-in at chest height
shots.motion: dust particles drifting in the light beams

shots.subject: top-down view of a barber station: straight razor, black combs, gold scissors, shaving brush, cream towel neatly arranged on dark walnut
shots.motion: warm light reflections moving on the metal

shots.subject: close-up of a black leather barber chair headrest and gold armrest
shots.motion: warm reflections gliding on the leather

shots.subject: floating dark wood shelves with rows of matte black and amber glass grooming products with gold caps, plain unlabeled packaging
shots.motion: light glinting on the gold caps

shots.subject: round gold-framed mirror reflecting the empty salon and the warm pendant lights
dark close-up of a gold hair clipper on black leather, very low-key lighting
shots.motion: faint golden glint along the blade
shots.notes: keep the image dark and calm with empty space in the center for the logo added in editing

negative_prompt: people, hands, faces, clients, barbers, body parts, reflections of people in mirrors, text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names, product labels, signage, watermark, subtitles, cartoon, illustration, CGI look, plastic textures, oversaturated colors, colors outside the black/gold/cream palette (blue, green, red, pink, cold chrome silver), neon lights, daylight, windows with outdoor views, harsh flat lighting, overexposed or blown-out highlights, blurry or out-of-focus subject, warped or melting objects, deformed tools, extra blades, duplicated objects, clutter, mess, hair on the floor, dirt, flicker artifacts, jitter, shaky handheld camera, fisheye distortion, dutch angle, low resolution, noise, grain artifacts, compression artifacts
